affected_subject.reason: Identifies L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange and its Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager interaction.

trigger_or_action.reason: Calling increaseLiquidityCurrentRange passes block.timestamp as the deadline argument.

direct_effect.reason: Deadline check becomes a no-op, allowing delayed transactions to be executed later by MEV/malicious actors.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected deadline protection vs actual no-op comparison of block.timestamp against itself yields a temporal safety relation.

summary: Report identifies the function, the block.timestamp deadline trigger, the no-op deadline effect enabling delayed execution, and the temporal safety relation basis.
